title: Phones by tenant country everywhere; full country list in desktop and driver app; Flutter currency formatting
goal: Accept and display phone numbers correctly for every target country, and show money in the driver app in the agency's currency.
why: backend/src/utils/phone.ts assumes country code 91 and 10 digits; the desktop PhoneInput has 30 codes; the driver app phone screen offers +91, +971, +966 and +1 only; packages/shared/lib/utils/currency_utils.dart uses lakh/crore grouping for everyone.
steps: Backend normalizePhone(raw, defaultCountry = tenant phone_default_country || 'IN'): E.164 using a static calling-code table for all ISO countries (generate desktop/src/lib/countries.ts and a backend copy from one source list: name, iso2, dial code, national number length range); callers that have a tenant context pass it (grep normalizePhone callers; inbound webhooks use the tenant of the receiving address).
Desktop PhoneInput: full country list with search, default from the locale store phoneDefaultCountry.
Driver app: country list from packages/shared/lib/constants/countries.dart with search; default from the agency (login response country) or device locale.
currency_utils.dart: format(amount, currencyCode, locale) via intl NumberFormat.simpleCurrency; lakh grouping only for en_IN; driver screens pass the agency currency from the login response.
tests: backend/test/utils/phone.test.ts: UK 07xxx -> +447..., UAE 05x -> +9715..., US 10 digits -> +1..., India unchanged, ambiguous input with tenant default.
desktop phone.test.ts updated; Flutter unit test for currency_utils (INR lakh, GBP, AED).
acceptance: No hardcoded 91 default in backend utils (grep).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
tasklist | findstr /i "java.exe dart.exe flutter"   # must print nothing; if a build is running, wait and ask the orchestrator
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8787/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/contacts.spec.ts e2e/fleet-drivers.spec.ts
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).
